import hashlib,itertools,json,math,statistics
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(".")
directory=root/"artifacts/engineering/irc_fit_probe_v1/probe"
sha=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
config_path=root/"research/irc-fit-probe-config-v1-attempt2.json"
config=json.loads(config_path.read_text())
receipt=json.loads((directory/"receipt.json").read_text())
capture=json.loads((directory.parent/"gpu-capture.json").read_text())
assert receipt["status"]=="pass" and not receipt["baseline_eligible"]
assert receipt["config_sha256"]==sha(config_path)
assert receipt["source_sha256"]==config["source_sha256"]
assert all(sha(root/p)==h for p,h in config["source_sha256"].items())
assert receipt["versions"]==config["expected_versions"]
expected={f"{a}-{g}-{i}.json" for a,g,i in itertools.product(config["applications"],config["groups"],range(config["repeats"]))}
assert expected==set(receipt["step_sha256"])
assert {p.name for p in directory.glob("*.json")}==expected|{"receipt.json"}
steps=[]
for name in sorted(expected):
 p=directory/name
 assert sha(p)==receipt["step_sha256"][name]
 row=json.loads(p.read_text())
 assert name==f'{row["application"]}-{row["group"]}-{row["repeat"]}.json'
 target=sum(x["target_tokens"] for x in config["expected_lengths"][row["group"]])
 positions=28+(target if row["application"]=="full" else 0)
 width=128*math.ceil(max(x["total_tokens"] for x in config["expected_lengths"][row["group"]])/128)
 assert row["target_tokens"]==target and row["active_positions"]==positions
 assert row["padded_shape"]==[2,width]
 assert all(math.isfinite(row[k]) and row[k]>0 for k in ["loss","gradient_norm","seconds","peak_memory_bytes"])
 assert row["changed_parameters"]==3
 steps.append(row)
logs=[json.loads(line) for line in capture["logs_stdout"].splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
assert len(logs)==19
assert sorted(logs[:-1],key=lambda x:(x["application"],x["group"],x["repeat"]))==steps
assert logs[-1]=={"event":"fit_probe_complete","status":"pass","steps":18}
state=capture["inspect"][0]["State"]
assert not state["Running"] and not state["OOMKilled"] and state["ExitCode"]==0
def nanos(t):
 from datetime import datetime,timezone
 main,fraction=t.rstrip("Z").split(".")
 return int(datetime.strptime(main,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp())*10**9+int(fraction.ljust(9,"0"))
container_s=(nanos(state["FinishedAt"])-nanos(state["StartedAt"]))/10**9

 rows=sorted([x for x in steps if (x["application"],x["group"])==(application,group)],key=lambda x:x["repeat"])
